title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function Rachel is using is a sum of squared errors, but it's weighted by the hours, $$x_i$$. Think about how this weighting affects the minimization process.

title: Differentiating the Objective Function
text: To find the value of $$\theta_1$$ that minimizes the objective function, consider taking the derivative of $$R\left(\theta_1\right)$$ with respect to $$\theta_1$$. What happens when you set this derivative to zero?

title: Simplifying the Derivative
text: After differentiating, you should have an expression involving a sum over $$n$$ terms. Try to simplify this expression by factoring out common terms.
